name: lens-diagnostic-pane
description: pi-goal-x–styled diagnostics pane above/below the editor, fed by pi-lens' public `pilens:diagnostics` event-bus payloads. Renders findings in a rounded, sectioned, color-coded box (brand header / Files section with fix-progress bar / updated footer) and hides itself when there is nothing to show. Requires pi-lens' native widget disabled via ~/.pi-lens/config.json (widget.visible=false). No pi-lens internals touched.
